A man in a striped shirt opens the fridge to reveal shelves stocked with drinks and eggs. The lighting is bright and even studio-style. (4) The scene transitions to the living area where a massive flat-screen television sits on a console, extremely close to a grey sofa. The men sit or stand around the TV, pointing at the screen which is displaying a vibrant image. He has his hands on his hips and a smiling expression.
